lines.text: My home screen had a problem. The troops moved... like cardboard cutouts.
And the flags? Stiff as a plank.
So I swapped them for the real battle troops. Same animations as in the fight. And real cloth on the flags.
My first try? They twitched like they'd had ten coffees.
Now they just stand and breathe, like real soldiers waiting for the fight.
What should I bring to life next?
